final: WITH order_fills AS (SELECT o.recordvault AS ordersmark, o.timespan, AVG(e.fillcount) AS avg_fill FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.recordvault, o.timespan), scored AS (SELECT ordersmark, timespan, avg_fill, AVG(avg_fill) OVER (PARTITION BY timespan) AS timespan_avg FROM order_fills), ranked AS (SELECT ordersmark, timespan, avg_fill, timespan_avg, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY timespan ORDER BY avg_fill DESC NULLS LAST) AS fill_rank FROM scored) SELECT ordersmark, timespan, avg_fill, avg_fill - timespan_avg AS excess_over_timespan_avg, fill_rank FROM ranked WHERE avg_fill > timespan_avg AND fill_rank <= 3 ORDER BY timespan, fill_rank, ordersmark
